author: jkasprza
title: PyTorch layer test test_tuple_unpack fails with TorchScript method redefinition on retry
signature: couldn't get torchscript module by scripting: retrying hit method redefinition|Flaky Test

failed_jobs.name: Pytorch Layer Tests / PyTorch Layer Tests
failed_jobs.symptom: test_tuple_unpack.py::TestTupleUnpack::test_tuple_unpack fails: RuntimeError on retry after TorchScript scripting error

key_errors: FAILED ../../../home/runner/_work/openvino/openvino/install/tests/layer_tests/pytorch_tests/test_tuple_unpack.py::TestTupleUnpack::test_tuple_unpack[ ie_device:CPU - precision:FP32 ] - RuntimeError: Retrying hit TorchScript method redefinition and can mask the original failure. First error: Couldn't get TorchScript module by scripting.
builtin cannot be used as a tuple: File "test_tuple_unpack.py", line 24, N, _, H, W = self.dims
Last error: Couldn't get TorchScript module by scripting. Exception: Can't redefine method: forward on class: __torch__.test_tuple_unpack.TupleArgument
root_cause: The pytest retry/rerun mechanism for layer tests re-invokes the test's model-tracing helper after an initial TorchScript scripting failure (caused by unpacking a tuple attribute with `_` placeholders, which `torch.jit.script` cannot handle via `builtin cannot be used as a tuple`). The retry attempts to redefine the `forward` method on an already-compiled TorchScript compilation unit, which PyTorch disallows, masking the original error with 'Can't redefine method: forward'. This is unrelated to the PR under test (src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/graph/impls/ocl/kernels_cache.cpp, a GPU kernel compile-flag change) and does not touch PyTorch frontend code; the same signature was previously observed in run 33753760233 (PR #37799) on 2026-09-03.
reproduction_steps: cd src/bindings/python/tests/layer_tests && python -m pytest pytorch_tests/test_tuple_unpack.py::TestTupleUnpack::test_tuple_unpack -k 'CPU and FP32' (reproduces intermittently; requires pytest-rerunfailures retry behavior to trigger the method-redefinition path).
recommended_actions: Disable or special-case pytest automatic retries for test_tuple_unpack (and other tests whose model triggers torch.jit.script failures) so retries don't attempt to redefine a TorchScript module in the same compilation unit.

Fix the underlying scripting incompatibility in test_tuple_unpack.py: the `N, _, H, W = self.dims` tuple-unpack-with-placeholder pattern is not supported by torch.jit.script; rewrite without the `_` placeholder or force tracing (example_input) instead of scripting for this test.
No action required on PR #39030 itself; this is an unrelated pre-existing flaky test in the merge queue.
prevention_strategies: Add torch.jit.script compatibility checks for layer-test forward() methods that use starred/placeholder tuple unpacking in CI linting, and avoid relying on the pytest retry-on-failure mechanism for tests whose failure mode (TorchScript module redefinition) is itself non-idempotent across retries.
historical_context: Identical failure signature (184bee2aff548cb1) previously recorded on 2026-09-03T13:13:23Z in run 33753760233 (PR #37799). This is occurrence #2 in the knowledge base; the rerun_search_string 'Couldn't get TorchScript module by scripting' is already approved in .github/scripts/workflow_rerun/errors_to_look_for.json, so the automated workflow rerunner should already catch and retry this class of failure.
